name: taskmaster-tui
description: Taskmaster in the terminal: review queue, this session's current task above the prompt, handovers pane, faults-only status line.

source.title: Data source
source.description: tm reads the Taskmaster MCP server; demo draws built-in sample data (screenshots and tuning without a backlog).

reviewScope.title: Review queue scope
reviewScope.description: waiting: in-review tasks that name a human action (the sign-off state). all: every in-review task, pre-protocol ones included.

reviewPhase.title: Review queue phase
reviewPhase.description: A phase id to limit the review queue to, as the board's phase filter does. Empty for every phase.

handoverGuard.title: Cache-cold handover guard
handoverGuard.description: After the idle minutes below with a big context and no handover yet this session, ask the model once to write a handover before the 1-hour prompt cache expires. Arms from the next turn end after enabling or a reload.

handoverGuardIdleMinutes.title: Handover guard: idle minutes
handoverGuardIdleMinutes.description: Minutes idle after a turn before the guard asks (at most 57; the cache expires at 60).

handoverGuardMinTokens.title: Handover guard: minimum context tokens
handoverGuardMinTokens.description: The guard asks only when the context holds at least this many tokens. The 200000 default targets 1M-context models: on a 200k window auto-compact acts first.
